newsitem.title: GERMANY: German public banks criticise Buba M3 policy.
newsitem.headline: German public banks criticise Buba M3 policy.

text.p: Germany's association of public banks (VOeB) on Thursday criticised the Bundesbank's decision to set a two-year money supply target as offering a "placebo" to financial markets instead of a credible policy.
The VOeB criticised the central bank's M3 monetary growth corridor of 3.5 to 6.5 percent as too broad, as well as leaving the option open to revise the target after a year.
"This contradicts the original goal of the money supply concept...as a reliable guideline," it said in a statement.
